_comment: Config for developing THIS repo (the plugin itself). Adopting projects copy plugins/pipeline/pipeline.config.example.json instead. Keys omitted here fall back to their documented defaults; the frontend and migration globs are left at their defaults because a plugin repo has neither, so they never match.

architecturalTriggers._comment: What forces the deep tier when the pipeline runs against its own source. The gates, the hooks, and the agent contracts are this repo's equivalent of a schema: a wrong edit there degrades every downstream project silently.
